atoms.sound: Hi, Jordan. What do you do as a doctor?
So I work in a hospital in Accident and Emergency, which is also called A and E. I treat people who need attention right away.
What type of people need attention right away?
For example, people who get into accidents and break their bones, people with a really bad fever, or just people who think they have a serious medical problem.

atoms.a: What does Jordan do for work?
Which types of people does Jordan treat?
b: ++He treats people who break their bones.
++He treats people with a bad fever.
++He treats people who think they have a serious medical problem.

atoms.sound: It can be. To become a doctor, you need to study for a long time, often 10 years or more.
The job itself is tough as well. I often treat patients in serious conditions, and sometimes they don’t survive.
Oh, that must be very hard for you.
Yes, having to tell their family members the bad news is the worst part of my job.

atoms.a: How long do you need to study to become a doctor?
b: ++You need to study for more than 10 years.
You need to study for 4 years.

atoms.a: What does Jordan say is the worst part of his job?
b: ++The worst part is telling family members bad news.
The worst part is treating patients in serious conditions.
The worst part is studying for a long time.

atoms.sound: Yes... I do. It makes me happy to help people. I also like the fact that I get to move around a lot. I couldn’t sit at a desk all day.

atoms.a: For which two reasons does Jordan like his job?
b: He likes sitting at his desk.
